title: session-relay.v1 — the typed session-start envelope
description: The whole envelope boot's session-start relay is built from. The platform never injects raw JSON — a validated envelope of this shape is rendered by the session_relay helper into a deterministic prose block. A fact may enter the envelope only under one of seven PUSH WARRANTS, and this schema's seven required top-level sections ARE that taxonomy: grounding_receipt (proof of grounding), identity (who/where this session is), authority_contract (the Explore write-gate contract shape), task_binding (verified-or-none, referencing session-binding.v1), action_forcing_alarms (compact, closed-enumeration alarms — never free prose), standing_directives (bounded operator-facing routing), and pointers (closed-enumeration pointers to points of use). additionalProperties is false at every object level so an unrecognized field is a schema change, never silent growth. Every machine-derived string anywhere in this envelope (worktree/branch/PR names, pin text, slugs, paths, memory excerpts) is DATA: the renderer must treat it as inert text and never let it forge relay structure.

grounding_receipt.description: Proof of grounding: the calm present-marker count line, and the consent-critical helper-availability state for both helper families. This section, together with action_forcing_alarms, MUST render inside the first 2,000 characters of output (the platform's injected-context preview truncates there).

present_marker_count.description: How many present markers grounding found this session. A plain count, not a list of the markers themselves.

helpers.description: Consent-critical availability for BOTH helper families — always both, so a missing helper is disclosed rather than silently absent from the envelope.

deployment.description: Closed enumeration: whether this session is running inside a project the engine is installed into, or inside the engine's own home repository (the mechanic).

label.description: Optional human-facing project or worktree label. Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

authority_contract.description: The SHAPE of the Explore write-gate contract. A later node populates this from modes.py at render time; this schema fixes what a populated contract must look like.

stance.description: The session's current operating stance, matching modes.py's three stances.

action_default.description: The gate's default disposition for an action it does not recognize. Closed to a single literal today (the write-gate's no-default-deny law); widening this enumeration is a deliberate schema change, never a free-form string.

blocked.description: The enumerable set of action codes the gate currently blocks while exploring. Closed enumeration — a new blocked action is a deliberate schema change, never free text.

provider_exceptions.description: Sanctioned per-provider differences in how the gate applies. `note` is machine-derived/authored data; render as inert text.

binding.description: Evidence shaped exactly like session-binding.v1 (worktree-keyed, with coordinator-snapshot and PR-contract expiry evidence). Duplicated inline rather than $ref'd across schema files so this envelope validates standalone.

task_binding.description: Either 'none' (no verified binding) or a 'verified' state carrying binding evidence shaped like session-binding.v1. See session-binding.v1.json for the authoritative evidence documentation.

action_forcing_alarms.description: A list of COMPACT alarms — each a short stable code plus minimal structured data, never free prose. Renders immediately after grounding_receipt, and both together must fit the first 2,000 characters.

standing_directives.description: Bounded operator-facing routing: the pins index, the execution posture, exactly two fixed non-mechanical routing lines, and a one-line labelled where-we-left-off pointer.

summary.description: Optional short summary of the pins. Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

execution_posture.description: The posture standing_directives reports — matches authority_contract.stance in a well-formed envelope, but is validated independently since this section stands alone in the render.

routing_lines.description: Exactly two FIXED, non-mechanical routing reminders. Each must be one of the canonical lines below — this is closed template text, never operator- or machine-supplied prose, so it cannot be used to forge relay structure.

enum: route personal working notes to the notebook; route project conclusions to memory

pointer.description: One-line pointer to where the prior session left off. Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

kind.description: Closed enumeration of pointer kinds. Adding a kind is a deliberate schema change.

ref.description: Optional machine-derived reference (a path, command, or slug) naming the point of use. Render as inert text.

pointers.description: Closed-enumeration pointers to points of use (e.g. the memory-recall procedure, Explore-scope detail, neighbourhood detail, a dashboard pull).

state.description: Closed enumeration of a helper family's consent-critical availability state.

alarm.description: One compact action-forcing alarm: a short stable code plus a data shape fixed BY that code (enforced by the if/then branches below), never free prose.
